result.summary: The screen is visually coherent overall; the clipped category chip, partial restaurant card at the right edge, and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scroll/viewport behavior and not defects. One content defect stands out: a promo badge displaying an implausible '-100%' value.

issues.description: The lower card shows a promo badge reading '-100%'. A negative one-hundred-percent value is not a meaningful discount label and looks like a bad or unformatted offer value rather than an intentional promotion.
issues.suggestion: Validate the discount before rendering; if the offer is fully free, label it 'Free' (or a proper percent-off like '-20%'), and hide the badge when the computed value is invalid.
